name: GXO Conair Distribution Center - Hagerstown MD

fieldNotes.imagery: Maxar satellite imagery (2026 capture cited, but content is mid-construction: slab + structural footings, only the north building wall partially erected). Facility is confirmed operational since March 2024. Gate/yard hardware not yet placed in the imagery, so entry-control fields are inferred from facility class, not observed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Web research confirms 378 dock positions across the building (GXO/Conair press materials). Solidly 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Press materials describe cross-dock loading functionality with 185-ft truck courts, implying dock banks on opposite building faces — treated as separate ship/receive.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred. A 2.1M sq ft single-tenant DC of this class (largest in Maryland, 700 jobs) is virtually always perimeter-fenced with a controlled truck gate; not visible because imagery predates fence installation.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred from facility class; not observable in construction-phase imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 185-ft truck courts plus extensive graded yard around three building faces support a large trailer drop capacity (50+ band, estimate ~250 capacity).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town setting: site fronts I-70 with farmland to the south and west, residential subdivisions north across the highway. Hagerstown is a small metro; classified Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box: ~668m N-S x ~875m E-W graded property — roughly 144 acres.
